# WedevsVnzla

> Venezuelan software studio. We build mobile apps, websites, CRMs and custom systems for growing businesses. Custom systems include payment and ERP integrations and AI automation.

The site is bilingual: English under /en/, Spanish under /es/.

## Pages (English)

- [Home](https://wedevs.page/en/): What we do, services, projects, how we work, and contact.
- [Services](https://wedevs.page/en/services): Services, process, ways of working, and FAQ.
- [Projects](https://wedevs.page/en/projects): Case studies of what we've built.
- [Blog](https://wedevs.page/en/blog): Technical writing from real projects.
- [Contact](https://wedevs.page/en/contact): Tell us about your project.

## Páginas (español)

- [Inicio](https://wedevs.page/es/): Qué hacemos, servicios, proyectos, cómo trabajamos y contacto.
- [Servicios](https://wedevs.page/es/services): Servicios, proceso, modalidades y preguntas frecuentes.
- [Proyectos](https://wedevs.page/es/projects): Casos de estudio de lo que hemos construido.
- [Blog](https://wedevs.page/es/blog): Escritura técnica a partir de proyectos reales.
- [Contacto](https://wedevs.page/es/contact): Cuéntanos sobre tu proyecto.
